PART III – LANDSPART III – LANDS
Land Redemption Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
ORDER UNDER SECTION 39A(1)

THE allotments speciﬁed in the Order No. 231 of 2015 made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1945/13 dated 15th December, 2015 are vested absolutely in the State and the possession of which has been taken for or on behalf of the State under Paragraph (a) of Section 40 of the aforesaid Act. But by the virtue of powers vested in me by Sub section (1) of Section 39(a) (inserted by Act, No. 8 of 1979) of the Land Acquisition Act, I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation, do hereby divest only the allotment speciﬁed in the Schedule below.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation.

My No.: 4-3/10/2012/LRB/328. Land Acquiring Ofﬁcer’s No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/KB/18.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, Land Secretariat,1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla,20th May, 2025.

PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
REVOCATION UNDER SECTION 39(1)

AN allotment of land speciﬁed morefully in the Order No. 231 of 2015 dated 07.12.2015 made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1945/13 dated 15.12.2015 was vested in the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. The possession of the land depicted below has not yet been taken for and on behalf of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. Therefore, I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation, by virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 39(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, do hereby revoke the Order in respect of the land speciﬁed in the Schedule of the Order No. 231 of 2015 dated 07.12.2015 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1945/13 dated 15.12.2015.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation.
